assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished panoramic background matte painting for the Ancient Gates side-scrolling 3D platform game. Create a very wide 3:1 landscape panorama, ideally 3072 by 1024 pixels, full bleed and opaque. Crash Bandicoot 4 inspired stylized tropical adventure art: sculpted warm sandstone ridges, layered jade rainforest canopies, distant blue-green mountains, a delicate distant waterfall and soft atmospheric cloud haze. Everything is distant scenery viewed horizontally across the valley, with the camera above the canopy looking toward far cliffs. The level's real 3D platforms and trees will sit in front of this painting. Use broad pleasing silhouettes, soft distant edges, warm sunlit rock faces, cool turquoise shaded depth, hand-painted stylized materials. Keep the central and lower-middle areas calm and low contrast for gameplay readability; build interest into widely separated landscape masses. Upper sky and outer edges dissolve gently into muted teal haze matching approximately #477e79. A few tiny weathered ruin silhouettes may be embedded naturally in the far cliffs. No totem poles, no stacked carved faces, no giant close-up gates, no nearby foliage framing, no foreground platforms, no floor or road receding into the image, no characters, no UI, no text, no border, no watermark. The two side edges should have similar soft mist and canopy density so overlapped panorama panels join quietly.
assets.conversion: WebP quality 86, no resampling or creative edits

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished panoramic background matte painting for the Gatekeeper's Hoard bonus area of the Ancient Gates side-scrolling 3D platform game.
